title: Record risk-proportional specification and evaluation decisions
description: Update only HANDOFF.md from the current origin/main checkpoint. Under Evaluation radar, incorporate the six already operator-approved decisions preserved in commit 5a101b63: one specification contract whose depth scales with delivery risk; evaluation evidence typed as deterministic, human, or model-derived with provenance and model metadata kept separate; multistack verification through detected runtimes and project-approved commands rather than bundled toolchains; pre-approval shaping of objective, tradeoffs, risk, and observable success without planner/auditor convergence; real failures feeding small versioned human-approved workflow proposals against an immutable baseline; and production evidence driving roadmap priority before any soft ratchet. Keep the handoff concise, do not add release history, dependencies, runtime behavior, gates, scores, or a second workflow, and do not modify any other file.
